name: searxncrawl
description: Web search via your own SearXNG and/or You.com, plus clean Markdown crawling with Crawl4AI and Playwright.
long_description:
Web search and clean Markdown crawling for AI agents.

- search: parallel SearXNG/You.com results; include_content also crawls result pages.
- crawl: one or many pages rendered in Chromium to Markdown or JSON.
- crawl_site: follow links within depth, page and timeout limits.
- Private SearXNG: optional basic auth and extra headers, including @/absolute or @~/ secret files.
- Crawling needs no search provider; Chromium installs automatically on first use.

author.name: DDM – Das Digitale Momentum GmbH & Co. KG

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the web through the configured providers (SearXNG, You.com) in parallel; results are merged and attributed per provider.

tools.name: crawl
tools.description: Crawl one or more URLs and return clean Markdown or JSON with metadata and references.

tools.name: crawl_site
tools.description: Crawl a website from a seed URL within depth, page and timeout limits.

searxng_url.title: SearXNG URL
searxng_url.description: URL of your SearXNG instance with JSON output enabled, e.g. http://localhost:8888. Leave empty to search with You.com only.

ydc_api_key.title: You.com API key
ydc_api_key.description: Optional. Enables You.com search; queries go to You.com (US).

searxng_username.title: SearXNG basic auth username
searxng_username.description: Optional; set both username and password, or leave both empty.

searxng_password.title: SearXNG basic auth password
searxng_password.description: Optional; set both username and password, or leave both empty.

searxng_extra_headers.title: SearXNG extra headers (JSON)
searxng_extra_headers.description: Optional JSON object of ASCII header values. Use @/absolute/path or @~/path for secret files; invalid configuration disables SearXNG.

search_result_fields.title: Search result fields
search_result_fields.description: Optional comma-separated fields: title,url,content,publishedDate,providers. Empty returns all fields.
